source_text: Critiques highlight methodological flaws, including non-causal associations, exclusion of maternal deaths skewing fertility data, insufficient sample size across countries, and reliance on single-timepoint surveys amid declining FGM trends, rendering the findings unproven and potentially misleading for policy.
